preconditions.description: The dimensions of the museum must be between 3 and 1000.
The number of starting positions must be at least 1 and at most the minimum of n*m and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in museum) and all(c in '.*' for row in museum for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each row of the museum must have exactly m characters, and each character must be either '.' or '*'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in starting_positions)
preconditions.description: All starting positions must be within the bounds of the museum.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly k integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(p, int) and p >= 0 for p in output)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == count_pictures(museum, starting_positions[i]) for i in range(k))
postconditions.description: Each output integer must correspond to the maximum number of pictures Igor can see from the respective starting position.
